newsitem.title: USA: US 1 Industries forms two corporations.
newsitem.headline: US 1 Industries forms two corporations.

text.p: US 1 Industries Inc said Tuesday it has formed two new corporations to offer various trucking and logistics services.

US 1 said it formed Carolina National Transportation Inc and Carolina National Logistics Inc. The company said it expects the two to be operating in multiple locations and to make "a substantial contribution" to its revenue in 1997.

US 1 said it named Martin Chitty as president and chief operating officer of the new corporations. He formerly served as vice president of operations at CMS Transportation Service Inc, the company said.
